tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs kyi 'khon sku 'bum byin can la nyams gso bgyis skabs gzungs 'phar song tho bkod pa bzhugs so// me glang zla 4tshes 16la 'khon sku 'bum g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs na yod par nyams gso mdzad skabs gzungs gnang bar/ thub dbang gi sku gser zangs ma mkhyid gang tsam gcig dam rdzas las grub rje btsun gong ma lnga'i sku chung ngu re/ slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum che tsam gcig maṅga'i mtshan can gcig 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum/ de bas chung tsam gcig grub thob thang stong rgyal po gcig tshe dpag med gcig mi 'khrugs pa gcig a ti sha gcig sātstsha gcig 'jigs byed gcig birwa pa chung ngu gcig sgrol dkar gcig spyan ras gzigs gcig rdor sems gcig gur mgon gcig rnams dam rdzas las grub pa/ yang 'phags pa rin po che'i gdung 'dam las grub pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i sku gcig sa bzang 'phags pa'i gdung 'dam las grub pa'i phyag rdor gcig 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi gdung 'dam las grub pa'i rje btsun grags pa'i sku gcig lta so bstan pa rab rgyas kyi gdung 'dam las grub pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i sku gcig thar rtse rdo rje 'chang gi gdung 'dam las grub pa'i tshe dpag med gcig yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi gdung 'dam las grub pa'i sgrol ljang gcig blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgyal mtsho'i gdung 'dam las grub pa'i mkha' spyod ma gcig rje btsun ma kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gdung 'dam las grub pa'i gshed dmar sku gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug sgrol dkar ljang / spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi sku re/ yang tshe dpag med dgu rnams a the drung gi gdung 'dam las grub pa'i rten 'dam ril bu gcig yang rdog tsam gcig byin sna bsdus pa'i zan ril nyer gcig rnams/ ༈ /yang dbu lo skor la/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seṅge/ sngags 'chang chen po ka spe bstan rab/ lo gsum gnang dus/ sngags 'chang grags blo/

mkhan chen dpal ldan bkra shis mkhyen brtse'i dbu tshab mkha' 'gro ma'i dbu skra/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ yab rje dam pa nyid kyi dbu lo/ ༈ /na bza'i skor la/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i slog bem/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dbu brnyes nang sbyongs dang sku chos dum bu/ sa paṇa gyi ske rags dum/ kha che paṇa chen gyi dbu zhwa dum/ ngor chen/ bu ston/ chos rje bla ma/ paṇa chen nags rin/ rong ston/ dkon mchog 'phel/ 'dren mchog sa lo/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gzhon nu blo gros/ sngags 'chang a mes zhabs/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ smin grol gling gter chen rnams kyi na bza'i tshal bu/ ༈ /yang shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dbang po gnyis kyi pur ras/ yang dbang phyug rab brtan na bza'/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i lo gsum gnang dus kyi na bza'/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'i tshal bu dang phyag phreng tsan ril la rdog gcig yang theg chen pur sha dang pu thal phran bu/ lha sa'i jo bo shākya rnam gnyis la sku khrus phul ba'i khrus rdzas kyi zan rdog dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i pu rus 'dres pa'i zan rdog bram ze dri med snying po'i rkang 'dres pa'i zan rdog pha dam pa'i tshems 'dres pa'i zan rdog yab rje bsod nams rin chen gyi phyag nas/ nged rang gi bsgrub pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i tshe ril rnams so/ /zhes pa'i zin tho 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'khon sku 'bum gyi nyams gso'i bskabs gzungs 'phar song tho bkod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
